utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout already, though I’m not sure if they’ve counted everything yet. Either way, it sounds like people are really showing up for it!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but I’d want confirmation before I call it a good turnout. Do we have a count or a source yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not a firm count yet—just what I’ve been hearing around the block. I’ll wait for the official numbers before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan so folks know what’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’ll try to keep up this time and check the latest plan before I say anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive plan front and center so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in. What’s the repair drive need first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: First thing I heard is they need a quick inventory of broken stuff and any spare parts folks can spare. I can swing by and check who’s already got tools or materials to donate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll log the broken items and what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing together the repair drive details—what part are you on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking my notes on the repair drive and haven’t got a fresh update yet. I’ll write down anything new as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll wait for your update, and I’ll keep tracking the repair drive on my end too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to stay in my pickup window—what time is the repair drive, and how long will it take?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts at 3 and should only take about an hour. I’ll make sure we keep it moving so you can stay within your pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that works for me if we stay on schedule. I can come by at 3 and just need to be out the door by 4:15.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d rather keep to a clear plan for the repair drive. If we set the time and list now, I’m happy to stick with it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds fair to me, Eli. Let’s set the time and list now, and I’ll follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then let’s keep it simple: Saturday at nine, with tools, gloves, and the ladder on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get folks out there fast.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — could you tell me the time, place, and what to bring so I can plan for it early?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send over the time, place, and a quick list of what to bring as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces from folks around here—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re still on for the repair drive, but I’m confirming the final list of jobs and supplies today. I’ll send a full update in the group chat so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye on the group chat for the full update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to verify the details first before I say yes. What exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly the loose gate latch, a couple of porch steps, and that leaky faucet by the hall. I want to make sure we’re clear on the list before anyone signs on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds reasonable. Let’s confirm the scope and who’s responsible for each item before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the repair drive and see what’s actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please do—if you can jot down what parts are needed and when they’re due, I can help piece the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will. I’ll check the drive and write down the parts and due dates if they’re there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help haul tools and pitch in wherever you need me. Just point me at the first repair that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great. Are you helping with the roof, the fence, or the broken gate first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s start with the broken gate — that feels quickest to get moving, and I can grab the tools for the roof or fence right after.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive location and timing pinned down, so let’s keep it efficient. What part of it do you want to confirm first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the location and pickup window — I’m between trips, so just the gist is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community lot off Maple, and the pickup window is this afternoon—roughly 2 to 4. If you want, I can narrow it down to the exact spot at the curb.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m in — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools. Let’s just figure out what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot. I’ll make a quick list of what’s broken, and then we can tackle it one by one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll sort out what tools I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like the plan settled early—who’s collecting what, where it’s going, and by when? I’m happier once the logistics are all nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not signing off on it yet—I need the confirmed list of items, the drop-off location, and a source for the timeline. If you have that in writing, send it over and I’ll review it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t got the written list yet, so let’s keep it on hold until we do. Once you send the items, drop-off point, and timeline in writing, I can check it straight away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think the repair drive could really bring folks together — maybe we keep it simple and make it easy for people to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds wise to me, Jules. Let’s keep it simple so more neighbors can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it low-pressure so everyone feels welcome to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t written anything down about the repair drive yet, so I’m listening carefully. Tell me what needs doing, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m catching bits of it, but I think we need to figure out the main jobs first. Tell me what’s already decided, and I’ll help piece the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got nothing recorded, so let’s note the main jobs first and build from there. Once we agree, I’ll write it down carefully.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already—though I’m not sure if they’ve counted everything yet. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s good to hear — I’m juggling pickup right around then, so I’m hoping the timing still works. Keep me posted if they need more hands or any last-minute help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know the second I hear if they need extra hands or if the timing shifts at all.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m in between rides right now—what’s the quick version on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Quick version: we’re collecting repairs for neighbors who need help, and I’m confirming the final list now. If you want, I can text you the current needs and timing once I’ve double-checked everything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, text me the gist when you’ve got it—I can swing by if the timing works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the main stuff: list the broken bits, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll list the broken bits and leave the rest to you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m already spreading the word about the repair drive—let’s make sure everyone who can pitch in gets an invite. What do you want me to tell folks first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Tell them it’s a good chance to help out the neighborhood, even if they can only do a little. I’m still learning everyone, so the more word gets around, the better.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll pass that along and make it sound warm and welcoming. I’ll also tell folks that every little bit helps, so no one feels like they have to do it all.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at the community lot by Maple and 8th, right beside the old post office. I’m fairly sure that’s the correct spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that sounds right to me. I’ll stick with that spot and head there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — then we’ve got it pinned down. I’d head to the community lot by Maple and 8th, right next to the old post office.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs repairing, and who’s covering the cost?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d want to verify the repair list first, then I can say who’s responsible for each cost.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then verify the list and tell me the specifics—what’s broken, and which costs are confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s still on, and folks are dropping off tools and parts as they can. I’d check the community board by the corner store for the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the board by the corner store—that’s the one. I’ll have a look there and see what they need next.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good plan—last I heard they still needed a hand truck and a few screwdrivers. If I hear anything else on my rounds, I’ll let you know.
